$description: test-ui rule table (data, not code): WCAG 2.2 AA subset the stdlib rules engine can measure. Project overrides win via ui/parity/config.json [rules]; thresholds come from qa/gates.toml [ui] → config.thresholds → skill defaults (DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS in parity.py). severity ∈ critical | serious | moderate | minor — only critical/serious make the verdict red; the rest are listed.

wcag.name.interactive.measure: every visible interactive item has a non-empty accessible name

wcag.contrast.text.measure: text/background contrast ratio ≥ contrast_text (4.5) or ≥ contrast_large (3.0) for large text; runtime uses computed colors composited over the effective background, source uses config.tokens.contrast_pairs

wcag.keyboard.measure: every visible interactive item appears in the Tab walk

wcag.heading.order.measure: heading levels do not skip within a screen

not_measured: 1.4.10 reflow (only overflow is measured, see reflow check)
